title: Code and data for a metagenomic study of kelp aquaculture effects on bacterioplankton and proteorhodopsin-based phototrophy
description:
Analysis code and processed data accompanying an in-preparation study of kelp (Saccharina japonica) aquaculture effects on bacterioplankton community structure and proteorhodopsin-based phototrophy in a subtropical coastal bay of China.

Six surface-water metagenomes (three kelp-farming stations, three control stations; Dongshan Bay, Fujian, China; January 2025) were analysed for bacterioplankton community structure, proteorhodopsin (PR) gene diversity, phylogeny, spectral tuning and abundance, and for genome-resolved PR host assignment across 131 metagenome-assembled genomes.

Contents: pipeline scripts (steps 1 to 10), one R script per study figure together with the input tables used only by that figure, the shared input tables in tab-separated text format, and the PR OTU consensus tree. Raw reads are available from NCBI BioProject PRJNA1532396.
